items.scene: Make a card for your mum! Cut a rectangle of card. Fold it in half. Think about your mum. What does she like? Does she like animals? Does she like sport? Or does she like flowers? Draw and colour a picture on the front of the card. Now open the card. Draw a picture of you with a big smile. Write in the card, 'Dear Mum, Thank you for everything you do for me.' Then write your name. Give the card to your mum.
